decisions.reason: The remaining board marks do not change the required BOM, manufacturing exports, part numbers, or component-role documentation.
The remaining board marks do not change the sensor-board BOM, Gerber archive, drill files, or pick-and-place deliverables.
The marking count does not alter the main-board production package or its component-availability issues.
Adding board marks has no necessary effect on component availability, sourcing standards, alternatives, or fallback rules.
The number of remaining board marks does not modify the requirement that every board use lead-free assembly.
Board identification marks do not change the task of reviewing component orientations in the manufacturing platform.
The client explicitly treats the marks as a separate remaining change they may add themselves; this does not alter the account-access, cart, or board-upload setup requirements.
The marking count has no effect on monitored rails, current coverage, monitor placement, or the selected monitoring IC.
The remaining PCB marks do not change the enclosure's board count, battery capacity, or mechanical accommodation requirements.
The board-marking change does not alter the required JST-GH connector count or peripheral connector set.
The remaining board marks do not change the LED count, LED model, package, part number, or other LED-array specifications.
The marking count does not change the main-board connector inventory, connector architecture, destinations, or connector counts.
